metadata.description: A Unique name used for the Virtual Machine domain and also for generating resource names. Defaults to a value prefixed with "aiovm-".
Type of authentication to use on the Virtual Machine. SSH key is recommended.
SSH key or password for the Virtual Machine. SSH key is recommended.
The size of the VM, at least 16GB RAM is required

variables.$fxv#0:
#cloud-config

write_files:
  # 1. Initial MOTD
  - path: /etc/motd
    owner: root:root
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      +------------------------------------------------------------+
      |          Azure IoT Operations Dev VM Provisioning          |
      +------------------------------------------------------------+
      | Status: Starting Up...                                     |
      | Action: Preparing automated setup                          |
      |                                                            |
      | The system will continue setup automatically after boot.   |
      | To monitor progress:                                       |
      | $ watch -n 1 -t cat /etc/motd                              |
      +------------------------------------------------------------+

  # 2. Setup service script - keeps running even after cloud-init is done
  - path: /root/setup_service.sh
    owner: root:root
    permissions: '0700'
    content: |
      #!/bin/bash

      # Create systemd service to run our provisioning
      cat > /etc/systemd/system/aio-provisioning.service << 'EOF'
      [Unit]
      Description=Azure IoT Operations Provisioning
      After=network.target cloud-final.service

      [Service]
      Type=oneshot
      ExecStart=/root/provision_ops_vm.sh
      User=root
      RemainAfterExit=yes

      [Install]
      WantedBy=multi-user.target
      EOF

      # Create the actual provisioning script
      cat > /root/provision_ops_vm.sh << 'EOF'
      #!/bin/bash
      set -eo pipefail

      # Log file setup
      LOG_FILE="/var/log/aio-provisioning.log"
      exec > >(tee -a ${LOG_FILE}) 2>&1

      echo "$(date): Starting Azure IoT Operations provisioning..."

      # --- Configuration ---
      MOTD_WIDTH=62

      # --- Helper Function: update_motd ---
      update_motd() {
          local status="$1"
          local details=("${@:2}")

          cat > /etc/motd << EOL
      +------------------------------------------------------------+
      |          Azure IoT Operations Dev VM Provisioning          |
      +------------------------------------------------------------+
      | Status: ${status}
      EOL

          for detail in "${details[@]}"; do
              echo "| ${detail}" >> /etc/motd
          done

          cat >> /etc/motd << EOL
      |
      | Log file: ${LOG_FILE}
      +------------------------------------------------------------+
      EOL
      }

      # Initial setup for package repositories
      setup_repositories() {
          update_motd "Setting up repositories..." "Adding Microsoft and Kubernetes repositories"

          # Setup Microsoft repo
          curl -fsSL https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/microsoft-archive-keyring.gpg
          echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/microsoft-archive-keyring.gpg] https://packages.microsoft.com/ubuntu/24.04/prod noble main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/msft.list
          echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/microsoft-archive-keyring.gpg] https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/azure-cli noble main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/azurecli.list

          # Setup Kubernetes repo
          curl -fsSL https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.32/deb/Release.key | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/kubernetes-archive-keyring.gpg
          echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/kubernetes-archive-keyring.gpg] https://pkgs.k8s.io/core:/stable:/v1.32/deb/ /" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/kubernetes.list

          # Update apt
          apt-get update
      }

      # Install required packages
      install_packages() {
          update_motd "Installing packages..." "This may take a few minutes"

          # Install essential packages
          apt-get install -y bash azure-cli kubectl git wget curl gnupg

          # Install Docker/Moby packages
          apt-get install -y moby-cli moby-engine || apt-get install -y docker.io

          # Install k3d
          curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k3d-io/k3d/main/install.sh | bash

          # Install Helm
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/master/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash

          # Install Step CLI
          STEP_VERSION="0.28.0"
          wget -q -O step.deb "https://github.com/smallstep/cli/releases/download/v${STEP_VERSION}/step-cli_${STEP_VERSION}_amd64.deb"
          dpkg -i step.deb
          rm step.deb

          # Install k9s
          K9S_URL=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/derailed/k9s/releases/latest | grep 'browser_download_url.*linux_amd64.deb' | cut -d '"' -f 4)
          wget -q -O k9s.deb "$K9S_URL"
          dpkg -i k9s.deb
          rm k9s.deb
      }

      # Configure Azure CLI and extensions
      setup_azure_cli() {
          update_motd "Configuring Azure CLI..." "Adding required extensions"

          # Install Azure CLI extensions
          az extension add --name azure-iot-ops --upgrade --yes || echo "Warning: Failed to add azure-iot-ops extension"
          az extension add --name connectedk8s --upgrade --yes || echo "Warning: Failed to add connectedk8s extension"

          # Azure login
          update_motd "Logging into Azure..." "Using managed identity"
          az login --identity

          # Set variables
          export MYUSER=$(id -un 1000)
          export MYHOME=$(eval echo ~$MYUSER)
          export MYWORK="/workspaces"
          export LOCATION="eastus"
          export RESOURCE_GROUP="my-iot-ops-rg"
          export RESOURCE_NAME="my-iot-ops-cluster"
      }

      # Create and configure k3d cluster
      setup_k3d_cluster() {
          update_motd "Creating k3d cluster..." "This may take a few minutes"

          # Delete existing cluster if it exists
          k3d cluster list | grep -q "^k3s-default" && k3d cluster delete k3s-default

          # Create new cluster
          k3d cluster create k3s-default \
            -p '1883:1883@loadbalancer' \
            -p '8883:8883@loadbalancer' \
            -p '8884:8884@loadbalancer' \
            --registry-create k3d-registry.localhost:127.0.0.1:5000 \
            --wait

          # Configure kubectl
          mkdir -p "$MYHOME/.kube"
          k3d kubeconfig merge k3s-default --kubeconfig-merge-default
          chown -R "$MYUSER:$MYUSER" "$MYHOME/.kube"
          chmod 600 "$MYHOME/.kube/config"

          kubectl config use-context k3d-k3s-default
          kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=azure-iot-operations
      }

      # Connect to Azure Arc
      connect_to_arc() {
          update_motd "Connecting to Azure Arc..." "Resource: $RESOURCE_NAME"

          az connectedk8s connect \
            --name "$RESOURCE_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --location "$LOCATION" \
            --correlation-id ""
      }

      # Setup Azure IoT Operations
      setup_iot_operations() {
          update_motd "Setting up Azure IoT Operations..." "Creating required resources"

          # Create storage account
          UNIQUE_SUFFIX=$(echo "$RESOURCE_NAME" | md5sum | head -c 10)
          STORAGE_ACCOUNT="stiot$(echo "$RESOURCE_NAME" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | head -c 10)$UNIQUE_SUFFIX"
          STORAGE_ACCOUNT=$(echo "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | head -c 24)

          az storage account create \
            --name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --location "$LOCATION" \
            --enable-hierarchical-namespace true \
            --sku Standard_RAGRS \
            --kind StorageV2

          SA_RESOURCE_ID=$(az storage account show --name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --query id -o tsv)

          # Create Schema Registry
          SCHEMA_REGISTRY="sr$(echo "$RESOURCE_NAME" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | head -c 10)$UNIQUE_SUFFIX"
          SCHEMA_REGISTRY=$(echo "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | head -c 24)
          SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE="srns$(echo "$RESOURCE_NAME" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]' | head -c 10)$UNIQUE_SUFFIX"
          SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE=$(echo "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | head -c 24)

          az iot ops schema registry create \
            --name "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --registry-namespace "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE" \
            --sa-resource-id "$SA_RESOURCE_ID"

          # Initialize IoT Operations
          az iot ops init \
            --cluster "$RESOURCE_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --no-tls

          # Create IoT Operations instance
          SR_RESOURCE_ID=$(az iot ops schema registry show --name "$SCHEMA_REGISTRY" --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --query id -o tsv)
          INSTANCE_NAME="${RESOURCE_NAME}-instance"

          az iot ops instance create \
            --cluster "$RESOURCE_NAME" \
            --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
            --name "$INSTANCE_NAME" \
            --sr-resource-id "$SR_RESOURCE_ID" \
            --broker-frontend-replicas 1 \
            --broker-frontend-workers 1 \
            --broker-backend-part 1 \
            --broker-backend-workers 1 \
            --broker-backend-rf 1 \
            --broker-mem-profile Low
      }

      # Final configuration and cleanup
      finalize_setup() {
          update_motd "Finalizing setup..." "Setting permissions and workspace"

          # Ensure kubeconfig permissions
          chown "$MYUSER:$MYUSER" "$MYHOME/.kube/config"
          chmod 600 "$MYHOME/.kube/config"

          # Create workspace directory
          mkdir -p "$MYWORK"
          chown -R "$MYUSER:$MYUSER" "$MYWORK"

          # Final successful MOTD
          update_motd "SETUP COMPLETE" \
            "Your Azure IoT Operations environment is ready" \
            "Run 'kubectl get pods -A' to see running pods" \
            "Run 'k9s' for a terminal-based UI"
      }

      # Main execution
      main() {
          update_motd "Starting provisioning..." "This will take 15-20 minutes"

          # Execute each step in sequence
          setup_repositories
          install_packages
          setup_azure_cli
          setup_k3d_cluster
          connect_to_arc
          setup_iot_operations
          finalize_setup

          echo "$(date): Azure IoT Operations provisioning completed successfully"
      }

      # Run the main function
      main
      EOF

      # Make the script executable
      chmod +x /root/provision_ops_vm.sh

      # Enable and start the service
      systemctl daemon-reload
      systemctl enable aio-provisioning.service
      systemctl start aio-provisioning.service

runcmd:
  - /root/setup_service.sh
